analysis_role: Post-outcome exploratory supplementary analyses; fixed before computing these supplementary results, not part of the original primary plan.
classifier: Unchanged frozen train_eval_ts, shrinkage 0.05, training-only reference, LSQR LDA with automatic shrinkage.

certificate.sample: Full target; no search for an illustrative subject or seed.

budget.seed_rule: numpy SeedSequence([bootstrap_seed, 4, subject, split]); one 999-row array; all budgets use nested prefixes and recompute studentizers and critical values.
budget.methodology: Original ci_gate_bspc_bootstrap_budget.discrepancy_bootstrap and calibrate; independent cache adapter only.
budget.interpretation: Numerical sensitivity only; selected-set stability does not validate simultaneous coverage.

block.methodology: Original ci_gate_block_bootstrap_sensitivity.riemann_estimates_and_block_bootstrap; common target resample across sources. First 10 primary half-splits, sorting screening indices back into cached recording order before resampling.
block.ordering_limitation: Ordered covariance arrays concatenate bar-task runs and omit short trials. Random half-split screening arrays omit additional trials. Circular blocks preserve order in these arrays, not uninterrupted physical time; blocks can cross gaps and run boundaries. This is a dependence sensitivity analysis, not validation of stationary time-series assumptions or coverage.

aggregation: Average seeds and splits within subject before equal subject averaging. All subjects and all fixed cases retained regardless of outcomes.
prohibited: No outcome-dependent subject, split, seed, source or model changes. No extra five-subject bootstrap-budget audit.
